description: Script for automating release version bumping based on commit history, PR labels, and component metadata. It analyzes commits since a given reference, determines version bumps for components, and optionally applies updates to metadata.yaml files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command options for the script.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines the component name based on a file path.

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Checks if a file path is related to documentation.

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the PR number associated with a commit.

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Retrieves labels for a given PR.

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next version and generation based on bump type.

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates the version and generation in a metadata.yaml file.
